diagnoses.lesson: Model parsing as an explicit state machine over UTF-8 bytes; track absolute offsets and record boundaries, and validate in the specified precedence before transforming data.
Validate inputs completely before mutating state, then traverse one component at a time and report errors at the earliest failing prefix; test boundaries, ordering, and owned data.
Separate syntax validation from value expansion, track UTF-8 byte offsets explicitly, and define delimiter and encoding edge cases before implementing.

diagnoses.bug: The requirements demand exact semver intersection and canonicalization over an unbounded prerelease order with discrete adjacency, while the public tests cover only basic intervals. This makes heuristic boundary or sample-based implementations likely to miss valid witnesses or empty intervals.
diagnoses.lesson: Model unbounded ordered domains and their successor rules explicitly; validate boundary behavior rather than inferring it from ordinary interval overlap.

diagnoses.bug: The implementation likely validates each row completely before moving on, allowing an earlier ragged row or invalid character to mask a higher-priority error found later.
diagnoses.lesson: Separate validation into ordered whole-input passes, so global shape and option errors take precedence over content errors.
Implement validation as ordered passes before transformation or arithmetic, preserving original indices and specified operation order throughout.
Model dependency resolution as deterministic depth-first search: recompute branch-local constraints, validate errors before choosing, and backtrack without leaking rejected state.

diagnoses.bug: The likely failure is implementing an arbitrary shortest edit script or grouping hunks by changed-row distance, rather than following the specified LCS tie-breaks and counting only intervening Keep rows.
diagnoses.lesson: Translate specifications into explicit invariants; preserve deterministic tie-breaking and track consumed indices separately from emitted rows when formatting grouped output.
Translate requirements into explicit validation order and atomic commit steps; check boundary arithmetic and preserve input order wherever observable.
Translate every requirement into explicit validation order and edge-case behavior before implementing; preserve state across segments and avoid overflow in long-running accumulations.
Separate parsing and validation from evaluation; track UTF-8 byte offsets, validate in specified order, and test empty fields and boundary cases.
Translate specifications into explicit parsing stages and error precedence; validate each stage before advancing, and keep parsing, comparison, and matching semantics separate.
Validate inputs in the specified global precedence before normalization or formatting, then compute shared dimensions and render deterministically.
Validate complete input before ordered semantic checks, and reduce exact arithmetic before enforcing representational bounds.
Translate every boundary, validation order, and cursor rule into explicit invariants; preserve them consistently across parsing and encoding.
Validate inputs in the specified precedence before transforming them, preserve source byte offsets through each stage, and test interactions between normalization, traversal, and recursive expansion.
Translate requirements into explicit validation, search, and formatting phases; preserve their stated ordering and recompute branch-dependent state after each choice.
Translate requirements into an explicit validation order and mutation boundary; compute fallible outcomes before committing state or recording events.
Validate complete input syntax before processing values, and define byte positions, precedence, and empty-value behavior explicitly.

diagnoses.bug: The task combines ordinary parsing and selection with exact set-existence, canonicalization, and minimum-cardinality conflict diagnosis, where subtle precedence and discrete-boundary cases are easy to mishandle.
diagnoses.lesson: For layered specifications, build shared semantic primitives first, then verify boundary cases and global validation order before adding derived operations or diagnostics.

lessons: Translate requirements into explicit invariants and ordered validation phases; validate complete inputs before transformation, evaluation, or mutation.

Build shared semantic primitives before derived behavior; test interactions, edge cases, deterministic tie-breaking, and formatting order.
